subject: ela
intro: Analyze main ideas and details in media.

items.prompt:
The central point of a video or chart is its:
A) main idea
B) title font
C) length

Facts that back up the main idea are:
A) supporting details
B) counterclaims
C) titles

A chart presents information:
A) visually/quantitatively
B) only in sound
C) only in a story

A documentary says 'ocean plastic harms sea life' and shows turtles tangled in nets. The footage:
A) supports and clarifies the main idea
B) contradicts it
C) is unrelated
items.answer: A) supports and clarifies the main idea

steps: Visual supporting detail. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) supports and clarifies the main idea

items.prompt:
How can a CHART clarify a topic better than words?
A) it shows patterns and comparisons at a glance
B) it hides the data
C) it adds no value
items.answer: A) it shows patterns and comparisons at a glance

solution.answer: A) it shows patterns and comparisons at a glance

items.prompt:
The difference between a main idea and a supporting detail is that the main idea is:
A) the central point; details give evidence for it
B) always a number
C) the same as a detail
items.answer: A) the central point; details give evidence for it

steps: Idea vs evidence. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) the central point; details give evidence for it

items.prompt:
You watch a news video and read an article on the same storm. Combining the video's footage and the article's data gives you:
A) a fuller understanding than either alone
B) less information
C) only confusion
items.answer: A) a fuller understanding than either alone

steps: Media + text = richer view. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) a fuller understanding than either alone

items.prompt:
An infographic on recycling shows a bar chart AND a short paragraph. To analyze it, you should:
A) identify the main idea and see how both the chart and text support it
B) read only the title
C) ignore the chart
items.answer: A) identify the main idea and see how both the chart and text support it

steps: Analyze all formats. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) identify the main idea and see how both the chart and text support it
